payout.saveError: Payout delay could not be saved.
payout.label: Payout delay (days)
payout.hint: How many days after a sale does this marketplace pay? If entered, your order record appears on the calendar and in the 30-day collection forecast. Leave it blank to create the record without a due date.

errors.shopifyAuthorization: The Shopify authorization address could not be obtained.

providerHints.trendyol: You can find these details in Trendyol Seller Panel → Account Information → Integration Information (only the primary user can view them). Your details are stored encrypted and are never displayed again.
providerHints.hepsiburada: You can find these details in Hepsiburada Seller Panel (merchant.hepsiburada.com) → Settings → Integrations. Merchant ID uses UUID format; your API username and password are used with Basic Authentication. Your details are stored encrypted and are never displayed again.
providerHints.n11: You can find these details in N11 Seller Panel (so.n11.com) → My Account → API Accounts. App Key and App Secret are sent in request headers; the store name identifies your connection. Your details are stored encrypted and are never displayed again.
providerHints.shopify: Enter your store's yourstore.myshopify.com domain. You will be redirected to Shopify's official authorization screen. LocalKarar requests read-only access to orders, products, inventory, and returns; the access token is never shown in the browser.
